describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): prove the carrier frontend/compiler-backend split (#807)

rule: Each case names its input, the required and forbidden outcomes, the contracts (PD..) and rows (CL.., H..) it exercises, the existing evidence that already pins part of it, and the node whose test makes it executable. Negative cases (PN..) are planted inputs a correct tree rejects for the stated reason; positive cases (PP..) are outcomes a correct tree preserves. UAI0 executes PN01-PN12 in subblock 4 against the implemented tree. A planted case is proven applied before its rejection counts. Work counters (WC..) reuse existing readers and are reported as counts and growth ratios; timing, allocation and memory figures are bench-m3 evidence only and never gate.

cases.name: Content-hash-only reuse
cases.input: Two parse requests for one canonical with identical bytes and parse_env_hash but a different ParserGrammarEpoch, SourceType, dialect or SyntaxProfileId (for example .ts read as TS, then the same bytes demanded as TSX)
cases.required: The second request misses and parses under its own identity; both artifacts carry their own ParseKey
cases.forbidden: A warm hit on a key made of content, path or parse_env_hash alone; a SourceType read only on the cold path

cases.name: TSX parser copy
cases.input: A second JS/TS/JSX/TSX parser: a vendored or forked copy of OXC, a hand-written TSX expression parser, or a direct oxc_parser::Parser::new outside the choke point
cases.required: Rejected; script syntax reaches OXC only through verter_parser::oxc_parse
cases.forbidden: Any second owner for the CL01 grammar contract

cases.name: Framework switch in a neutral parser
cases.input: A neutral parser (HTML, CSS, Markdown, JSON) with a branch, mode or table keyed by a framework or carrier name (a Vue directive rule in the HTML tokenizer, an Angular mode in HTML, a React branch in Markdown)
cases.required: Rejected; carrier-specific syntax lives in the carrier's own home (DK3 fork or DK4 parser) and dialects are owner-declared typed tables
cases.forbidden: A neutral owner naming a consumer carrier or profile

cases.name: Tooling-only carrier forced through a compiler backend
cases.input: A tooling-only carrier (the Astro row) whose parse, diagnostics or IDE projection requires a compiler-backend registration, or whose ParserDecision names a compiler
cases.required: The frontend parses and tooling demands are served with no backend row; a compile demand reports UNSUPPORTED
cases.forbidden: A stub backend, a parser that imports an LC module, a parser decision that implies compiler support
existingEvidence: CPF0 case table PC04 and PC06

cases.name: 'HTML-like' or family-wide key
cases.input: A cache, ownership or selection key spelled as a parser family ('HTML-like', 'template'), a FrameworkProfileId, a FrameworkTag or a file extension
cases.required: Rejected; keys are (CarrierProfileId, ParserGrammarEpoch) for ownership and PD03 for reuse
cases.forbidden: Two carriers sharing one artifact because they share a family

cases.name: Parser selection from an unresolved framework name
cases.input: A file whose framework profile is unresolved, an unknown adapter spelling, or a FrameworkTag value with no registered row
cases.required: No parser is selected from the name; the typed unsupported or unknown outcome is returned
cases.forbidden: Falling back to the nearest carrier's parser; rewriting an unknown carrier onto Vue or Svelte
existingEvidence: verter_language FRAMEWORK_SYNTAX_COMPATIBILITY_DOMAIN keeps catalog misses off Vue/Svelte

cases.name: Shared recovery semantics without proof
cases.input: A ForkAndSpecialize parser that declares its source's recovery behaviour without running its own malformed corpus
cases.required: Rejected until the fork's own recovery corpus passes

cases.name: Omni parser
cases.input: One parser serving two exact grammar contracts by a runtime carrier switch (for example one template parser for Vue, Svelte and Angular with a mode argument)
cases.forbidden: A grammar selected by a runtime carrier argument inside one parser

cases.name: Fork without lineage
cases.input: A ForkAndSpecialize or NewParser decision with a missing source owner, license, oracle corpus or with a commit SHA, hash or URL as lineage
cases.required: Rejected as a structural manifest failure

cases.name: Parser in the parser-free closure
cases.input: A parser module under crates/verter_language (for example src/carriers/<carrier>) or a parser dependency of verter_session_query, verter_type_engine, verter_type_expr or verter_execution

cases.name: Third-party product parser or regex option
cases.input: A third-party parser crate as a product parser dependency, oxc_regular_expression as a direct dependency, or parse_regular_expression: true
cases.required: Rejected; the only admitted third-party parser is OXC for CL01
cases.forbidden: Any product parser outside the in-house owners
cases.atHead: the toml crate in verter_validation_probe is PAR-D01 and in xtask is PAR-D02 (both TOMLX)

cases.name: Overlay or attachment declaring a parser
cases.input: A React, Solid, Preact, Qwik, Stencil, Lit, Alpine, htmx or Stimulus profile registering a CarrierFrontend or a grammar config; a second Markdown parser for MDX
cases.required: Rejected; overlays reuse CL01, attachments reuse CL10/CL04 and codecs, MDX extends CL32
cases.forbidden: A family parser for a DK5 row

cases.name: Parse once per parse key
cases.input: The pinned Vue and Svelte corpus through parse, geometry, eval source, template facts and lowering
cases.required: One carrier parse per ParseKey; lazy declaration bodies lower once through the retained snapshot; publishing an artifact lowers zero bodies
cases.forbidden: A re-parse of one ParseKey; a second parse or lowering cache

cases.name: Exact, deterministic parse identity
cases.input: Identical inputs, then each parse-affecting input changed alone
cases.required: Identical inputs share one ParseKey with pinned canonical bytes; each parse-affecting change produces a different key; diagnostics are repeatable and source-bound
cases.forbidden: A key that changes with provider order, a parse-affecting change that keeps the key

cases.name: Neutral HTML fork
cases.input: The neutral HTML parser built from the Vue tokenizer lineage
cases.required: A PD04 lineage record; no Vue directive, interpolation or component rule; no manifest edge back to verter_parser's Vue tokenizer; its own WPT and malformed corpus pass
cases.forbidden: A dependency on the Vue tokenizer; Vue syntax accepted by the neutral parser

cases.name: Lossless round trip and recovery for an owned parser
cases.input: Each owned parser's pinned valid corpus and malformed corpus
cases.required: Byte-exact reconstruction from tokens and trivia; a tree plus located diagnostics for every malformed input; later spans unchanged after a local error
cases.forbidden: A panic, an abort, a dropped byte or a normalised token
cases.receivingAcceptance: each row's grammarSlot and recoverySlot. A PAR-T id is a transferred obligation in parser-inventory.v1.json: the receiver's charter is amended to add an acceptance whose text is that obligation, and the slot is rebound to that acceptance. Until then the named acceptance does not carry the proof.

cases.name: Grammar-epoch change invalidates the changed parse and its dependents
cases.input: Bump one carrier's ParserGrammarEpoch with the bytes unchanged
cases.required: Exactly that carrier's syntax artifacts miss. Every other carrier stays, and every semantic cache entry that did not observe the changed parse stays. A semantic result that observed the obsolete parse misses even when its FrameworkProfileId is unchanged; after the epoch change that warm result equals a fresh result.
cases.forbidden: A family-wide or global invalidation; a stale warm hit of a result derived from the obsolete parse
existingEvidence: verter_session resolver_store contributor FileSourceEnv includes ParseKey
